LanguageData.SmallWoodenResearchTable.label: Small Wooden Research Table
LanguageData.SmallWoodenResearchTable.description: A simple stone table with pestel mortar for grinding herbs scones and mixing liquids. Also a tablet for recording observations. Researchers work here to discover new things.
LanguageData.WoodenButhersTable.label: Small Wooden Butchers Table
LanguageData.WoodenButhersTable.description: A heavy table for butchering dead creatures into pieces of raw meat.
LanguageData.WoodenStoneWorkingStation.label: Wooden Stone Working Station
LanguageData.WoodenStoneWorkingStation.description: A stone table with simple stone tools used for cutting and Chisseling stone chunks into usable blocks.
